reason: First run (commit e6e1f60 prereg) produced an INVALID index: requiring >=30 valid names/day dropped 40-80% of sessions in 2017-2020 (valid days: 2019=57 of 259), so row-based shifts/MA200 spanned gaps. This is a construction defect found from COVERAGE counts, not from performance. DISCLOSURE: the first run's performance numbers (negative timing excess in all windows) were seen before this amendment; the first-run result is RETRACTED (kept as market_timing_result_v1_RETRACTED.json). If v2 differs in sign from v1, treat with suspicion.
